CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_authz.assert_transaction(x mixer_authz.transaction_identity_v1)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF session_user<>'mixer_hosted_runtime' OR current_setting('role')<>'none' OR current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' OR x.backend IS DISTINCT FROM pg_backend_pid() OR x.full_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id()::text OR x.database_name IS DISTINCT FROM current_database()::name OR x.runtime_role IS DISTINCT FROM session_user::name OR x.nonce IS NULL OR x.nonce !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' OR x.nonce IS DISTINCT FROM nullif(current_setting('mixer_authz.invocation_nonce',true),'') OR x.deadline IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(x.deadline) OR x.deadline<=clock_timestamp() OR x.deadline>clock_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds' OR x.deadline::text IS DISTINCT FROM nullif(current_setting('mixer_authz.deadline',true),'') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'transaction context rejected' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_authz.bounded_text(t text, hi integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT coalesce(octet_length(t) BETWEEN 1 AND hi,false) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_authz.finite_uint(n numeric, lo numeric, hi numeric)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT coalesce(n IS NOT NULL AND n::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') AND n BETWEEN lo AND hi AND trunc(n)=n,false) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mixer_authz.valid_id(t text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT coalesce(octet_length(t) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND t COLLATE "C" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$',false) $function$
